newsitem.title: USA: Bion Environ sees losses in next 3 qtrs.
newsitem.headline: Bion Environ sees losses in next 3 qtrs.

text.p: Bion Environmental Technologies Inc on Monday predicted that it would incur at least three more quarters of financial losses.
The company also said its results for the quarter ended March 31 would show limited sales revenue and a substantial loss from operations.
"The company expects to continue to incur losses for at least the next three quarters," the company said in a statement.
It added that the company "currently targets reaching 'cash flow break even' on an operating basis by the end of fiscal 1998 (June 30, 1998).
Bion Environmental provides systems for treating waste and wastewater.
